On Wednesday, June 2, 2021 at 10:21:50 PM UTC+10 PARTHIBAN PERIASAMY wrote:
Greetings,

Firstly, I would like to thank you for providing an open source MS statistical analysis tool .
Currently, I am comparing differential protein abundance across 10 cell lines (each cell line has 3 biological repeats and each biological repeat has 3 fractions). I have utilised MSFragger to perform my quantification search and utilised MSFragger output - MSstats.csv file as input to MSstats (v3.22.1). MSstats input attatched in this thread for your reference. Additionally, I have provided the QC_Plot with the appropriate labeling (provides a better summary of my file sets).

I would like to perform group comparison between cell line (BT474 VS HS578T) and (BT474 VS T47D). Based on the user manual provided I wrote the group comparison command (Rscript provided for your reference).

After successfully running the command, the ListofDiffProteins.csv file contains NA or 0 values throughout columns of "pvalue" and "adj.pvalue" (have provided the ListofDiffProteins.csv file in this thread for your reference).

I suspect that I am performing the group comparison incorrectly. Is it possible that you advise me on how I should write the group comparison command to analysis even numbered samples?

Regards,
Parthiban

messages.author: bc13a282f8b0c08b
messages.subject: Re: Advise on group comparison matrix
parts:
Hi,


the issue column in groupComparison outputs indicates if there was a problem with fitting a model for comparing groups. In your data, there is a lot of messages indicating that there are no measurements for one of the groups or both groups. In these cases, there is nothing to compare, so no p-value is produced. This could be either a data problem (too much missigness) or a problem with annotation. Is your annotation file correct? Follow-up question based on your script: does MSFragger indicates censored values by 0? If so, you should use the option censoredInt = "0" in dataProcess.


Kind regards
Mateusz
